cognitive_evolution.previous_paradigm: Ad-hoc debugging where script fixes are kept local to a single ATS portal run, creating the risk of repeating similar investigative steps on other platforms.
cognitive_evolution.new_paradigm: Universal Reverse-Engineering Playbook: Treating every web portal deconstruction as a systematic 6-phase engineering lifecycle (Reconnaissance -> Parser Triage -> Element Deconstruction -> Framework Commit -> Scoped Verification -> Human Gate). Documenting generic patterns (e.g. reactive combobox vs text input, parser enum pill loss, lifetime certification date handling, career-aligned skill date distribution) so any future AI can instantly deconstruct any ATS (Workday, Oracle, Greenhouse, Lever, SmartRecruiters, etc.).
cognitive_evolution.reason_for_shift: User explicitly emphasized institutionalizing the reverse-engineering capability into permanent, high-leverage AI documentation and cognitive assets.

long_term_application: When encountering any new ATS portal or complex form, future AI agents must consult docs/UNIVERSAL_ATS_REVERSE_ENGINEERING_PLAYBOOK.md and docs/ORACLE_HCM_ATS_DEEP_DIVE.md first. Always fingerprint the reactive engine before interacting, verify parser artifacts for missing pills or inverted dates, target exact element names rather than naive fallback inputs, apply career-proportional experience dates, run scoped error queries to avoid background widget noise, and never submit without explicit human confirmation.
